falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the bottom pattern match, as that level held in the referenced bottom formation; this would signal structural weakness rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained volatility expansion contradicts the bottom_2024_aug pattern which featured VIX peaking near 28 and rapidly mean-reverting; persistent fear indicates distribution, not capitulation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Flight-to-quality bid in bonds combined with equity weakness signals recession panic rather than soft-landing bottom; the August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable/rising as growth fears abated

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
